$comment: ADR-2122 (custody X-1 step 1, W1): the single source for per-role service accounts. flake.nix bakes /etc/passwd and /etc/group from it, and `agentbox-manifest role-accounts isolate` derives /etc/supervisord.roles.conf and the /run/secrets delivery plan from today's rendered supervisord.conf with it. Inert unless [security].role_isolation = true. A secret is EITHER `source` (a file path; the program's own environment= value for `env` wins over it) OR `from_env` (a PID-1 environment variable, written to the file and unset before supervisord). `env` names the variable the program reads the path from; the isolated config points it at /run/secrets/<role>/<file>. Never put a secret VALUE here.

reserved_ids.965: host docker group: docker-compose.override.yml group_add. A role whose gid is 965 would sit in the Docker socket's group, and the Docker daemon is root on the host.

roles.name: ab-identity
roles.purpose: identity signer: the nostr-pod-bridge daemon (relay slot, NIP-59 unwrap). Sole holder of the sovereign/operator, JunkieJarvis and concierge keys; the identity port (W3a) serves every other caller.

roles.name: ab-gateway
roles.purpose: nostr-gateway: operator DMs and relay AUTH. Holds no key; signs through the identity port (W3a), reads the AoE bearer through the aoe-share copy (design 2.6, W2).

roles.name: ab-ingress
roles.purpose: nip98-proxy: the LAN door. Break-glass bearer and session secret.

roles.name: ab-spend
roles.purpose: hitch host and pay402 spend keys. Account only in step 1: owner disposition Q6 defers the spend port (W5), so pay402 and Hitch stay devuser-class.

roles.name: ab-sidestr-dreamlab
roles.purpose: sidestr:dreamlab producer: block-signing key and parent RPC credential.

roles.name: ab-faucet-dreamlab
roles.purpose: sidestr:dreamlab faucet: treasury key. 965 is skipped (reserved_ids).
